name: Datapass
product_goal: Prepare for data-engineering coding and technical interviews through fast drills, notebooks, algorithms and graded exercises.

current_state.summary: The current qualified V1 is broader than the target product and already contains notebooks, Arena, DuckDB/DuckLake, Python/pandas/Polars, dbt, pipeline/model/chart resources, SparkLab and Fabric donor code.
current_state.release_truth: Current main remains the implementation authority until the refocus is actually performed.
current_state.important_asset_status: Do not delete broad V1 assets before their target product has extracted or reused what it needs.

thin_optional_surfaces: small DuckDB/DuckLake data explorer for current exercise fixtures
Airflow Python scratchpad: code -> parse/validate -> DAG preview
owns: coding algorithms and DE coding patterns
does_not_own: warehouse/lakehouse engineering curriculum beyond small fixtures
full visual Data Factory pipeline product

fastapispark.product_exposure: Keep PySpark notebook freedom, but do not turn Datapass into the Spark simulation product.

fastapiflow.product_exposure: Only lightweight Airflow coding and DAG preview in Datapass.

planned_extractions.asset: dbt Core runner, artifacts and dbt project surfaces
charts, dimensional model and SCD teaching resources
Fabric/ADF pipeline donor UI including Mapping Data Flow

planned_extractions.action: move product ownership while keeping shared execution service

non_goals: becoming a complete cloud data platform
hosting a production Spark or Airflow cluster
